Interface HEnumeration

All Known Implementing Classes:
EnumerationAdapter
public interface HEnumeration
An object that implements the HEnumeration interface generates a series of elements, one at a time. Successive calls to the nextElement method return successive elements of the series.

For example, to print all elements of a vector v: 

     for (HEnumeration e = v.elements() ; e.hasMoreElements() ;) {
         System.out.println(e.nextElement());

     }

Methods are provided to enumerate through the elements of a vector, the keys of a hashtable, and the values in a hashtable. HEnumerations are also used to specify the input streams to a SequenceInputStream.

NOTE: The functionality of this interface is duplicated by the HIterator interface. In addition, HIterator adds an optional remove operation, and has shorter method names. New implementations should consider using HIterator in preference to HEnumeration.
